# APIs | Autodesk Platform Services

## Overview
Autodesk Platform Services (formerly Forge) provides a suite of APIs and services that enable developers to build applications that integrate with Autodesk products and services.

### General Information
- [Autodesk Platform Services (formerly Forge)](https://aps.autodesk.com/): This page provides an overview of Autodesk Platform Services, detailing its capabilities and how it can be utilized by developers to enhance their applications.

### Getting Started
- [Getting Started | Autodesk Platform Services Tutorials](https://get-started.aps.autodesk.com/): A comprehensive guide for new users to begin using Autodesk Platform Services, including setup instructions and initial steps.

### Partnerships
- [Partnerships | Autodesk Platform Services (formerly Forge)](https://aps.autodesk.com/partnerships): Information on how to partner with Autodesk and leverage the platform's capabilities for mutual benefit.

### Events
- [Autodesk Devcon Europe 2025](https://aps.autodesk.com/DevCon): Details about the upcoming Autodesk Developer Conference in Europe, focusing on networking and learning opportunities for developers.

## Technical Resources
- [Maya API | Autodesk Platform Services (APS)](https://aps.autodesk.com/developer/overview/maya): Documentation on the Maya API, detailing its features and how to use it within Autodesk Platform Services.
- [Manufacturing | Autodesk Platform Services](https://aps.autodesk.com/manufacturing): Information on how Autodesk Platform Services can be applied in the manufacturing sector.
- [Revit SDKs and Tools - Autodesk Platform Services](https://aps.autodesk.com/developer/overview/revit): A resource page providing details on SDKs and tools available for Revit within Autodesk Platform Services.

## Community and Support
- [Autodesk Developer Network](https://aps.autodesk.com/adn): A platform for developers to connect, share resources, and get support related to Autodesk Platform Services.
- [Forge Partner Talks - Autodesk Platform Services](https://aps.autodesk.com/partnertalks): A series of discussions and presentations from partners using Autodesk Platform Services, sharing insights and experiences.
